name: How do I know if I need a new toilet during a bathroom remodel?

mainEntity.name: How do I know if I need a new toilet during a bathroom remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Consider a new toilet if your current one is old, frequently clogs, leaks, or has visible cracks. Remodeling is an ideal time to upgrade to a more efficient or modern style that complements your new bathroom design. You might also choose a new toilet for improved water efficiency or comfort, especially if your current model is outdated. Alpha-Plumbing Services can help assess your existing toilet's condition and advise on whether replacement is beneficial for your remodel in Goodyear, Buckeye, or surrounding areas.
acceptedAnswer.description: Assess if your toilet is old, leaks, or clogs often. A remodel is a good time to upgrade for efficiency or style.
